purpose: Use a resemblance to describe an action or noun.
keywords: Noun + のように / のような; plain phrase + ように / ような.
I want to fly through the sky like a bird.
It is a white flower like snow.
Please write it as the teacher said.
formation: Noun + のように / のような; plain phrase + ように / ような.
restrictions: ように modifies a predicate; ような modifies a noun.
mistake: Do not interchange な and に without changing the following structure.
